# Legend — registration accuracy

Registration holds separately acquired panels of one section in a common frame, and the per-arm
agreement is what the accuracy claim rests on.

## Panels

@fig:anchor-overlay   two-colour anchor-channel overlay of two separately acquired panels, before
                      and after alignment. Same physical section. Scale bar required.
@fig:dice-by-arm      per-arm Dice of the binarised anchor masks, both accuracy presets crossed
                      with micro-registration on and off, against the rigid-only and
                      no-registration baselines.
